loop.top3_why: The mean of the full pool (strategy A) offers the most stable performance across the three validation windows (0.65, 0.6667, 0.6833) and avoids the extreme volatility seen in the weighted forward‑selection approach (B). The DBA approach (C) is also stable but its score is slightly higher than A, and the mean is simpler and more likely to generalize.
loop.top3_why_not: B, while having the lowest mean validation score, shows a highly unstable per‑window performance (0.451 and 0.847) indicating overfitting to one window and poor generalization. C, though stable, has a higher mean score than A and offers no clear advantage over a plain mean in this context.
